info.name: UPS Export Assure Commodity Compliance Guidance
info.description:
Notifies if a commodity in your shipment is prohibited by the destination country, or if additional documentation is required for the shipment to clear customs.

Visit the full [UPS Export Assure Documentation](https://developer.ups.com/api/reference?api=exportassure) for more details!

You can also view our [Export Assure Product Information](https://developer.ups.com/api/reference/exportassure/product-info) to see what this API integration can do for you.

This is a premium API offering that incurs cost on API usage, and is currently only available for our US-based subscribers.
